generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural elements. A thick, dark green curved line begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left, resembling the left side of a heart shape. Mirroring this green line on the right is a stylized wheat stalk, depicted in a light tan or yellow hue, completing the heart shape. Inside this heart shape are four individual agricultural elements, each a different color. The top element is a green apple, oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the apple is a yellow banana pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue-green avocado is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the avocado is a red apple, oriented horizontally with its stem pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the avocado and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
